subject: general
question: The production function of a firm is a relationship between inputs used and _______.

options.text: quality of inputs used by the firm
quantity of inputs used by the firm
price of inputs used by the firm

solution:
The correct answer is __**output produced by the firm**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The production function relates inputs used to outputs produced.
 
• It's a mathematical/functional representation of this relationship.
 
• It shows the maximum output possible with given inputs.
 
• It assumes efficient operation.
 
• Inputs are resources used in production.
 
• Examples of inputs: labor, capital, raw materials, land, technology.
 
• Outputs are the goods/services produced.
 
• The function describes the *maximum* output possible.
 
• It's crucial for economics and business management.
 
• It helps determine the most efficient input combinations.
 
• It analyzes the productivity of different inputs.
 
• It's used for forecasting future output levels.
 
• It assists in production capacity planning.
 
• It helps understand economies of scale.
 
• It can be analyzed in the short run and long run.
 
• In the short run, at least one input is fixed.
 
• In the long run, all inputs are variable.
 
• The law of diminishing returns applies in the short run.
